title: Zesty Citrusy Italian Butternut Squash Trofie
description: A citrusy and snappy Italian dish featuring butternut squash, perfect for a post-workout meal. This sugar-free-friendly recipe is made with trofie pasta and flavored with zesty citrus.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the trofie pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the garlic until fragrant.
Add the cubed butternut squash to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the lemon juice and orange zest, and season with salt and black pepper.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet, tossing to combine with the squash mixture.
Transfer the pasta to a serving dish and top with shaved grana padano cheese.
Garnish with additional orange zest if desired.
Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
